recordLookups.description: Retrieves the ChangeRequest record using the input recordId parameter to fetch Revision_No__c and Drawing_URL__c fields for display context
recordLookups.label: Get Change Request
recordLookups.name: Get_Change_Request

screens.name: Display_Context
screens.description: Displays read-only context information (Revision Number and Drawing URL) from the ChangeRequest record to provide field technician with necessary reference data
screens.label: Display Context

fields.name: revisionNumber
fields.description: Displays the Revision Number from the retrieved ChangeRequest record as read-only context for the field technician

fields.name: drawingUrl
fields.description: Displays the Drawing URL from the retrieved ChangeRequest record as read-only context for the field technician

screens.name: Confirmation_Instructions
screens.description: Confirmation screen providing instructions to the field technician about marking Application Status to complete. No record updates occur; technician clicks Finish to complete the orchestration step.
screens.label: Confirmation Instructions

fields.name: instructionText
fields.description: Displays static instructions to the field technician to mark each affected unit's Application Status to complete on the related items list. This is a work-guide confirmation step with no data input required.
fields.fieldText:
Instructions:

Please mark each affected unit's Application Status to complete on the related items list.

Once you have completed this task, click Finish to complete this step.

variables.name: recordId
variables.description: Input variable containing the ChangeRequest record Id passed to the flow for lookup operations
